components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single most important action on a form or screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #f59e0b; color: #09090f; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 10px; border: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d97706; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f59e0b55; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default for secondary actions, back buttons, navigation CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #13151f; color: #94a3b8; border: 1px solid #1a1f2e; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #1a1f2e; color: #e2e8f0; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #f59e0b55; outline: none; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions: delete, remove. Never for primary workflow steps.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #2d0a0a; color: #f87171; border: 1px solid #3f1515; padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #3f1515; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Always paired with a visible label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; margin-bottom: 13px; } .ds-lbl { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.07em; } .ds-inp { background: #13151f; border: 1px solid #1a1f2e; border-radius: 10px; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; width: 100%; transition: border 0.15s; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-inp:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f59e0b55; } .ds-inp::placeholder { color: #475569; }

components.description: Sidebar navigation button. Amber text on active; muted on inactive.

narrative.overview:
The Management System is an operator's tool, not a product showcase. Every screen opens to its essentials — the overview surfaces what matters right now, the modules hold the full picture. The interface is dark, precise, and unhurried. The surface reads like a room where the lights are intentionally low so the data can glow.

Density is controlled but never cramped. Labels are small and uppercase. Numbers are large and monospaced. The hierarchy is clear without being loud. There is no onboarding flow, no empty-state illustration, no celebration animation when a record is saved. The tool assumes competence and respects the user's time.

This system explicitly rejects the SaaS dashboard reflex: no hero metrics with gradient accents, no pastel card grids, no startup-cute illustrations, no Dribbble-template aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layering across four surface levels, no shadows
Single amber accent used as a signal, not decoration
Monospaced font for every numeric value
Uppercase, tight-tracked labels; never decorative heading chrome
Gently rounded corners (10px inputs, 14px cards), never sharp, never pill-shaped
Transitions at 150ms; state changes only, no choreography

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on no more than 15% of any screen. Its rarity is the signal. When everything is amber, nothing is.

rules.name: The Semantic Lock Rule
rules.body: Green is paid/success. Red is overdue/danger. Blue is clients. Purple is time. Never swap or reuse outside their role.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value uses the mono stack. Amounts, durations, counts, dates in tables. Never body font for numbers.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are uppercase and tracked at 0.07em at 11px/700. Never title-case for secondary chrome.

rules.name: The Shadow Ban Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow for elevation. The single permitted glow is the focus ring: border-color #f59e0b55 on focused inputs.

rules.name: The Backdrop Rule
rules.body: Modals use backdrop-filter blur(6–10px) over a #000000 88–99% scrim. The only permitted blur in the system.

dos: Do use #f59e0b exclusively for monetary values, the active nav item, primary buttons, and active progress.
Do use the mono stack for every number: amounts, durations, dates in tables, invoice numbers.
Do write all secondary labels in uppercase with 0.07em letter-spacing at 11px/700.
Do use the four-layer surface system to establish depth without shadows.
Do keep transitions at 150ms. State changes only.
Do use ghost buttons as the default for any non-primary CTA.
Do keep the overview module minimal: essential aggregates and a short list.
Do size touch targets at 44px minimum height for mobile.
donts: Don't use amber outside monetary values, active states, and primary actions.
Don't break the semantic color locks: green/red/blue/purple each own one role.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't add glassmorphism effects outside modal backdrops.
Don't replicate SaaS dashboard clichés: hero metrics, identical card grids, pastel palettes, large illustrations.
Don't add onboarding animations or automatic motion when a view loads.
Don't use placeholder text as a substitute for a visible label.
Don't invent new background colors outside the four established surface levels.
